description: This Java source file defines a package-private, non-thread-safe class 'JsonFieldSelectorTrie' that represents a trie data structure to efficiently manage JSON field selectors or pointers. It includes methods for building the trie from JSON pointers, adding paths, and traversing the trie, optimized for JSON field selection operations within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: JsonFieldSelectorTrie
classes.description: A package-private, non-thread-safe class representing a trie structure for JSON field selectors, supporting insertion and traversal operations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a 'JsonFieldSelectorTrie' instance from an iterable collection of 'JsonPointer' objects.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Expands the trie to include the path specified by a 'JsonPointer'.

methods.name: addJsonKeyIterator
methods.description: A private helper method that adds a path to the trie based on an iterator of 'JsonKey', used internally for recursive path insertion.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the trie has any child nodes.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the set of keys corresponding to this trie's immediate children.

methods.name: descend
methods.description: Retrieves the child node associated with a given 'JsonKey'; returns an empty trie if the key is not present.
